text:
**Topology: two-stage Miller-compensated op-amp with an NMOS input pair and nulling-resistor compensation.**

- **Stage 1:** an NMOS differential pair (M1, M2) with a PMOS current-mirror load (M3, M4).
  - The diode-connected side is on the vinn device. The first-stage output is taken at the vinp device's drain.
  - So when vinp rises, node x falls, the PMOS second stage M6 pulls harder, and vout rises. vinp is therefore the non-inverting input.
- **Stage 2:** a PMOS common-source stage M6 with an NMOS current-sink load M7.
- **Bias:** the 10 µA reference is sunk by the diode-connected NMOS Mb. Mb is mirrored to the tail source M5 and the output sink M7.
- **Compensation:** Miller capacitor Cc in series with nulling resistor Rz, connected from node x to vout.

**Hand sizing (initial point):**

| Quantity | Target | Reasoning / value |
|---|---|---|
| Tail current | ≈30 µA | Slew rate Itail/Cc ≈ 30 V/µs with Cc = 1 pF (spec ≥ 14 V/µs) |
| gm1 | ≈200 µS | GBW = gm1/(2π·Cc) ≈ 30 MHz; gm/Id ≈ 13 |
| Output current I7 | ≈200 µA | Output-side slew I7/(CL+Cc) ≈ 65 V/µs |
| gm6 | ≈1.5–2 mS | Well above 2.2·gm1·CL/Cc ≈ 0.9 mS, giving phase margin above 61° |
| Rz | ≈1.5 kΩ | A little more than 1/gm6, so the zero moves into the left half-plane |
| W6/W3 | ≈ 2·I6/Itail ≈ 13 | Keeps the systematic offset low |
| Gain | ≈ 35–40 dB per stage | L ≈ 0.6–1 µm; the total should be above 72 dB, and the optimizer can raise the L values for margin |
| Input pair area | moderately large | Keeps 1/f noise at 1 kHz below 310 nV/√Hz |

```spice
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* bias: sink the 10uA reference
Mb   ibias ibias vss  vss nfet W={WB} L={LB}
* tail current source
M5   tail  ibias vss  vss nfet W={W5} L={LB}
* NMOS input pair (M1 = non-inverting side, drives node x)
M1   x     vinp  tail vss nfet W={W1} L={L1}
M2   d2    vinn  tail vss nfet W={W1} L={L1}
* PMOS mirror load, diode on the vinn side
M3   d2    d2    vdd  vdd pfet W={W3} L={L3}
M4   x     d2    vdd  vdd pfet W={W3} L={L3}
* second stage: PMOS common source + NMOS sink
M6   vout  x     vdd  vdd pfet W={W6} L={L3}
M7   vout  ibias vss  vss nfet W={W7} L={LB}
* Miller compensation with nulling resistor
Rz   x     cz    {RZ}
Cc   cz    vout  {CC}
.ends dut
```

  "WB": [4, 1, 20],
  "LB": [1, 0.5, 3],
  "W5": [12, 3, 80],
  "W7": [80, 20, 400],
  "W1": [10, 2, 60],
  "L1": [0.6, 0.3, 2],
  "W3": [10, 2, 60],
  "L3": [1, 0.5, 3],
  "W6": [130, 30, 800],
  "RZ": [1500, 200, 20000],
  "CC": [1e-12, 0.3e-12, 3e-12]
}}
